fusions.name: Polyp Lace
fusions.desc: Flicks out a lace fringe of feeding polyps, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and healing you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Shipwreck Trawl
fusions.desc: Casts a coral-crusted trawl at an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 26 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, up to 1.3 times as much at full reach, and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Reef-Crusted Mantle
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Living Weave
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
